THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

An allotment of land called “Winchfieldpark Watta” in extent ofabout 12.9745 Hectares, depicted as Lot ‘A’ in the Advance TracingNo. Maha/UDD/2016/384 dated 26.12.2016, prepared by theSurveyor-General, situated in the Village of Karambakatiya in theMinor Division of Gandeka Korale in the Divisional Secretary’sDivision of Udadumbara in Kandy District of Central Province andbounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Winchfieldpark Watta – Extent: 10.9859 HectaresNorth and East: Winchfieldpark Watta, claimant not known; South:Stream; West: Stream and Winchfieldpark Watta, claimant notknown.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
Ref. No.: 4-3/2/2010/FR/207.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.11th April, 2019.
